status: Source review: confirmed implementation gaps; no behavior pass claimed

findings.observed: claim_provider_job revalidates the original task effect, but provider_chat_context::begin separately uses the backing credential for context_view. The original invocation grant and task context ceiling are absent from that selection.
findings.required: Derive task context admission from the committed effect and current original grant. A Send-only grant must not export history; authorized task recall must remain source-backed and bounded.

findings.observed: claim_provider_job reads provider_context.chat_id by route_id, without a task or invocation scope. A task send with no context selection can therefore reuse an earlier provider chat history.
findings.required: Task delivery must not inherit a route-wide previous_chat_id. Preserve conversation continuity through explicitly authorized local projections.

findings.observed: finish_provider_job inserts the reply as an ordinary provider message. It does not use the committed provider_job effect link/question message to add a task reply event or wake its waiting task.
findings.required: Use the exact durable job/question binding to record the response atomically with job completion. Terminal tasks retain the communication as unassigned; never infer task identity from a sender or route.

qualification: Local source review only. The active frozen-source workspace run tests the preceding checkpoint; it cannot establish these missing behaviors.
pending_verification: Send-only grant with broad backing credential cannot disclose context or previous provider chat history
Permitted bounded task recall contains source provenance, omission and a checkpoint with no other-conversation content
Two tasks in one conversation receive only their own provider replies despite reordered completion
Cancelled/expired tasks preserve incoming communication without resuming
Duplicate completion and replay do not duplicate a message or inbox effect
Failure during reply persistence rolls back the whole completion
